name: Sitka Gold Corp.
summary: Sitka Gold Corp. engages in the exploration of mineral resource properties in Canada and the United States. It explores for gold, silver, and copper deposits. The company holds 100% interest in the RC Gold property that comprising 2,169 claims covering an area of approximately 447 square kilometres located in Yukon's Tombstone Gold Belt in the Yukon Territory, Canada. Sitka Gold Corp. was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
